alerts.headline: Heat Advisory issued October 16 at 8:41PM PDT until October 17 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...High temperatures in the upper 80s to the mid 90s expected.

* WHERE...Orange County Coastal Areas and San Diego County Coastal
Areas.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM PDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Heat related illnesses increase during hot temperatures.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Low temperatures will be in the high 60s to
low 70s.

alerts.headline: Air Quality Alert issued October 16 at 6:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...The South Coast AQMD has issued an air quality alert due to
increased fine particle pollution from wildfire smoke.
Visit https://www.aqmd.gov/alertinfo to check current and forecasted
air quality levels.

* WHERE...in the areas of San Clemente, Dana Point, San Juan
Capistrano, and Laguna Niguel. Levels of particle pollution can
vary by time and location depending on fire activity and local
weather conditions.

* WHEN...from 4 PM Friday to 10 AM Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Particles in wildfire smoke can get deep into the lungs
and cause serious health problems such as heart attacks, stroke
